goal: Accept, route for repair, or block one already implemented Paravoxia chapter by binding an exact candidate revision to the chapter registry, signed council and scene authority, functional and audiovisual runtime proof, immediate previous and next chapter continuity, fresh independent reviews, and a final evidence-backed disposition without letting the acceptance team patch its own findings.

inputs.description: The bounded request to accept one already implemented chapter.
The repository boundary containing candidate source, authority, tests, runtime, and evidence.
The stable registered chapter ID under acceptance.
The exact immutable source revision or explicitly hashed working-tree snapshot being judged.
The current read and capture authority, protected paths, and separate publish boundary.
The machine-readable chapter and child-scene registry with entry and exit contracts.
The executable semantic authority for objective placement, interactions, entity lifecycles, reload seams, recovery behavior, and exact registry projections.
The approved story-council candidate, decision register, three signatures, and owner decision for this chapter.
The signed child scene contracts and their current hashes.
The immediate previous chapter runtime exit evidence or signed exit contract when runtime is unavailable.
The immediate next chapter runtime entry evidence or signed entry contract when runtime is unavailable.

roleContracts.title: Shipped Story And Authority Inventory Verifier
Independent Narrative And Council Compliance Auditor

gates.title: Acceptance is bound to one exact revision and cannot patch or publish
Chapter registry, executable journey contract, neighbors, council authority, and child scene authority resolve to current hashes
Implemented chapter maps bidirectionally to approved council and scene authority
Registry, journey semantics, static checks, source mapping, and runtime authority pass on the exact candidate revision
The bound browser evidence and complete chapter journeys pass for the exact candidate
Immediate previous-to-target and target-to-next chapter handoffs preserve story, control, audiovisual, and UX state
Continuous chapter audiovisual, accessibility, variant, reset, and performance proof is complete and authentic
Story, score, cinematography, UX, blind, and implementation reviews are complete and independently authored
Every independent finding is losslessly represented in one canonical defect register
No unresolved critical, high, or unaccepted material medium chapter defect remains
Chapter cohesion score, category floor, and per-child floor pass the acceptance profile
The deterministic quality audit validates optional human taste provenance and accepted-disposition evidence
Acceptance artifacts are substantive, current, independent, hashed, and complete
Final council disposition binds exact authority, mechanical proof, defects, score, and authenticated taste state
Acceptance summary and reusable lessons are durable

Bind Final Council-Owned Chapter Acceptance Repair Or Blocked Disposition

stopConditions.description: Exact-revision authority, functionality, implementation, boundaries, audiovisual quality, independent review, cohesion score, conditional headed taste, artifact quality, and lessons all pass.
Machine and independent-review gates pass, but headed real-GPU or audible human taste is still required before accepted disposition.
Acceptance found repairable defects and emitted an evidence-bound commission for a separate creative-triad run; no acceptance role patched source.
Registry, signatures, exact revision, neighboring context, required runtime proof, or independent evidence is missing or stale.
The operator stopped the read-only acceptance run without changing source or publishing.

qualityQuestions: Is the exact candidate revision registered, fully inventoried, and bound to current council and child scene signatures?
Does every approved beat exist and does every implemented beat have authority?
Can a first-time player complete the whole chapter manually without rescue while movie, resume, reset, and plausible detours remain honest?
Do previous-to-target and target-to-next boundaries preserve story, save, control, objective, camera, palette, reality, score, and mix state?
Do story, score, image, interaction, implementation, performance, and accessibility form one authored chapter across all child scenes and variants?
Were all six independent reviews isolated and losslessly represented in canonical defects?
Did acceptance remain read-only and emit a bounded repair commission instead of patching its own findings?
Is the disposition accepted, machine-ready-for-human-taste, repair-required, or blocked without overstating evidence?
